bio.text: Jasmine Clark is the Democratic nominee for Georgia's 13th Congressional District in the November 2026 general election.
She has represented District 108 in the Georgia House of Representatives since January 2019.
Clark was born in Atlanta and, as of 2020, lived in Lilburn, Georgia.
She holds a bachelor's degree in biological sciences and a master's degree in microbiology and molecular genetics, and has worked as a scientist and a professor.
